fixture: tapa-floorplan model fingerprints for the golden vadd-floorplanned design
scope: every LpModel the two formulations hand to the solver, in solve order, recorded through RecordingSolver over the real CBC backend

fields.phase: partition = placement ILP; routing = finish-plan routing ILP(s)
fields.vars / constraints: variable and constraint counts as built
fields.nonzeros: nonzero canonical coefficients, objective plus rows
fields.var_domains: fnv1a-64 of every variable's (kind, lower, upper), in model order
fields.objective: fnv1a-64 of the canonical objective: coefficients summed per variable, exact zeros dropped, terms sorted by variable index, constant last (reordering-equivalent models hash equal)
fields.rows: fnv1a-64 of canonical rows (operator, constant-folded rhs, canonical terms) sorted as whole strings (reordering-equivalent models hash equal)
fields.exact_lp_text: fnv1a-64 of the exact CPLEX-LP text CBC parses (order-sensitive; the strongest gate)
fields.solve_status / solve_objective: the outcome CBC returned for this model
